meta_description:
28 likes, 0 comments - the_temptationalley on February 12, 2026: "If you want to use all the veggies that are in your fridge and make some movie night snack this salad is perfect. It has carrots, spinach, onion, capsicum and you can also add corn.
.
Ingredients- 1/2 tsp chilli powder and cumin powder ( add more if you can handle spice 
- 4 tbsp hot oil 
- 1/2 tsp sesame seeds 
- 1 tbsp lemon juice 
- salt as per taste 
- veggies of choice I used carrots, spinach, onion and capsicum ( add corn if you have ) 
- chips of choice 
- jalapeños ( 4-5 ) 
.
#saladsofinstagram #healthysalads 
( high protein salad, salad videos, food videos, chips, crips, wafers, vegetable salad )".
